project_type: Expo React Native mobile app + Node.js Express backend monorepo
build_system: Expo SDK 50 with EAS Build, Node.js backend
test_framework: No test files found in the project
build_command: N/A - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, cannot install or build
verification_instructions: AST validation via TypeScript compiler checks (npx tsc --noEmit) not available due to network. Manual code review for syntax correctness.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot npm install, cannot add new packages to node_modules, cannot run builds. Can only modify source files and package.json. User will install locally.
contribution_requirements: Commit directly to fix/final-stabilization branch. One commit per logical fix.

key_patterns.state_management: Redux Toolkit with slices in mobile/src/store/slices/
key_patterns.api: Axios instance at mobile/src/services/api.ts with interceptors for auth tokens
key_patterns.navigation: React Navigation 6 with AuthStack (Login, SignUp, Otp, CmsPage) and AppStack (all app screens)
key_patterns.auth_flow: App.tsx dispatches loadAppState() then conditionally dispatches setCredentials(). RootNavigator checks isAuthenticated/isGuest from Redux.
key_patterns.styling: React Native StyleSheet with lightColors theme from mobile/src/theme/colors.ts
key_patterns.backend_media: multer memoryStorage -> Cloudinary upload -> MongoDB Post.media[] array

directory_structure: monorepo: backend/ (Express API), mobile/ (Expo RN app), admin/ (Vite React admin panel)
